description: This file defines classes and templates for WebSocket protocol handling, including WebSocket link types, client and server implementations, and protocol specifics such as frame types and request/response management within the WPEFramework Web namespace.

classes.name: Protocol
classes.description: Handles WebSocket frame encoding/decoding, request/response key generation, and control frame management.

classes.name: RequestAllocator
classes.description: A singleton pool allocator for Web::Request objects.

classes.name: ResponseAllocator
classes.description: A singleton pool allocator for Web::Response objects.

classes.name: WebSocketLinkType
classes.description: Template class defining the WebSocket link behavior, including data transmission, state management, and upgrade handling for both client and server.

classes.name: WebSocketClientType
classes.description: Template class for WebSocket client implementation, managing connection states, data exchange, and upgrade procedures.

classes.name: WebSocketServerType
classes.description: Template class for WebSocket server implementation, handling incoming connections, upgrades, and data flow.

methods.name: ResponseKey
methods.description: Generates a WebSocket response key based on a request key.

methods.name: Encoder
methods.description: Encodes data frames for WebSocket transmission.

methods.name: Decoder
methods.description: Decodes incoming data frames for WebSocket reception.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of the allocator.
